reason: The README describes a Web UI capability inspector and diagnostic tool that reports built-in capability state and can persistently modify a narrowly defined set of nine UI controls.

summaries.zh: 用于检查 DeepSeek Harness Web 的内置能力状态、筛选诊断条目，并管理少量经审阅的界面开关。
summaries.en: Inspects built-in capabilities in DeepSeek Harness Web, supports diagnostic filtering, and manages a limited set of reviewed UI toggles.

capabilities: Inspect built-in capabilities and configuration state
Generate a redacted diagnostic report for copying
Modify and persist settings for nine reviewed Web UI controls
